text: Risk management is a vital skill in both business and daily life. It begins with identifying risks, which means looking ahead to spot potential problems that could derail your goals. Once you know the dangers, you can create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact, such as improving safety procedures or diversifying investments. However, not all risks can be avoided, so it is also wise to prepare contingency plans. These are backup actions you can take if something unexpected happens. Finally, effective risk management requires constant monitoring. By regularly reviewing your situation, you can spot new threats early and adjust your approach, ensuring you are ready for whatever comes your way.
